toni: FYI onboarding sampleapp POC broke. Node + Python return different embedding lengths when using batch helper. Node -> 768, Python -> 512.

lee: any quick repro?

toni: minimal payloads below. Node request:```json
{"model":"embed-lite-v1","inputs":[[0.2,0.3]],"pad_to":768}
```Python request:```json
{"model":"embed-lite-v1","vectors":[[0.2,0.3]],"pad_to_len":768,"trim_zero_tail":true}
```Result: Node client sees 768-d vectors; Python client trims zeros and stores 512-d.

dev-ops: this explains duplicate index entries — retries create different shapes and dedupe fails. Are retry headers aligned?

lee: found it: Node sets `Idempotency-Key`. Python retryer uses `X-Req-Id` internal header but doesn't map it to `Idempotency-Key` -> retry dupe. Also older python client serialized rerank `scores` as strings.

sdk-qa: proposed fix list: 1) unify option name -> `pad_to` across SDKs, 2) default `trim_zero_tail=false` in python, 3) map retryer id to `Idempotency-Key`, 4) add client-side sanity check asserting all embeddings in batch share the same dim and that rerank scores parse as floats.

toni: + server-side guard: if request includes pad_to, server should return `meta.embedding_dim` and reject variable-length batches (400).

lee: opening quick PRs: sdk-python patch to rename arg + map header, sdk-js note to ensure it sets Idempotency-Key, server PR to surface embedding_dim.

sdk-qa: adding an integration test that runs Node+Python sampleapps together with randomized lengths (N=100) and asserts dims match and no duplicate inserts after simulated 409s.

ci-bot: ci: triggered for sdk-python PR #1820 (unit,lint,int).

toni: status?

lee: patch landed in python branch, staging run green for dims and score types. Will cut a patch release after one more smoke run.

sdk-qa: staging smoke passed. No dupes in 1500 requests. Closing P0.

toni: thanks everyone :thumbsup:
